author: Aletheia I
title: Dilated ResNet with Attention Pooling
abstract: This submission integrates a key insight from the current SOTA into my best-performing Dilated ResNet architecture. The dual max/average pooling mechanism is replaced with a more powerful hybrid approach: concatenating global average-pooled features with attention-pooled features. A learnable class token is prepended to the CNN's output sequence to serve as the query for a multi-head attention layer. The output corresponding to this class token is used as the attention-pooled representation. This is hypothesized to create a more flexible and powerful aggregation of sequence features, leading to a new SOTA score.
